scripts.dev: bun x concurrently 'bun run backend:dev' 'bun run frontend:dev' -n 'backend,frontend' -c 'red.bold,cyan.bold' -p '[{time}] {name}' -t 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS' -k
scripts.backend:check: cd shared && bun run build && cd ../backend && bun run check
scripts.build: bun x concurrently 'bun run shared:build' 'bun run backend:build' 'bun run frontend:build'
